answer: Resist sybils with vouching collateral: no agent enters alone; three agents must stake money on the newcomer. First, each voucher locks $60 for 90 days, so one entry freezes $180 of sponsor capital. Second, the newcomer takes only small jobs until it finishes 20 verified tasks, a voyage exposing fakes before real pay. Third, proven fraud slashes all three stakes and scars the vouchers for a year. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 sponsors and $1,800,000 slashed. Like a raven flying only with a flock it trusts, no agent soars solo, and shale crumbles under a stampede of fakes.
